select m.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId , m.IND_ID indId , m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL portfolioLevel , m.START_DATE startDate , m.END_DATE endDate , n.IND_NAME indName , n.IND_TYPE indType , n.EXPR , n.SUP_FREQUENCY , n.WARN_COND warnCond , n.FOUL_COND foulCond , n.TIME_POINT timePoint , case when m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL='02' then ( select group_concat(PORTFOLIO_ID ) as portfConst from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL x where x.PTL_BAG_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID group by PTL_BAG_ID) else null end portfConstId from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID and n.IS_ENABLED=#{isEnabled} and n.TIME_POINT like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{timePoint}),'%')
(m.PORTFOLIO_ID =#{portfolioCode} or m.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL where PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioCode}))
and ( ( (instr(n.SUP_DISPLAY_CLASSIFY,'01')>0 or n.SUP_DISPLAY_CLASSIFY is null)
and m.START_DATE <= date_format('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then date_format('2999-01-01','%Y-%m-%d') else m.END_DATE end) >= date_format('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d')
) or ((instr(n.SUP_DISPLAY_CLASSIFY,'02')>0
and (case when n.INVEST_PROPORTY is null then #{investProporty} else n.INVEST_PROPORTY end ) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{investProporty}),'%')
and m.START_DATE <= date_format('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then date_format('2999-01-01','%Y-%m-%d') else m.END_DATE end) >= date_format('${valDate}','%Y-%m-%d')
)))
